Overview

Shanghai is a city in Shanghai with a population of 24,870,000. China’s largest city and global financial hub, known for its futuristic Pudong skyline, historic Bund waterfront, and dynamic cultural scene. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. The overall cost of living is above the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
